reviews.snippet:
Manager Nithin provided an extremely disappointing experience. He turned off the lights without any warning or heads-up that it was getting late, and when we asked for them to be turned back on so we could finish our food, we were made to wait for around 30 minutes.

His behavior came across as rude, unprofessional, and unnecessarily disrespectful. It felt as though he intentionally made the situation difficult for us instead of handling it professionally. This was extremely poor service and completely ruined our experience. Very disappointing.

We’re genuinely sorry to hear about your experience, and we’re disappointed that your evening ended on such a frustrating note. This is certainly not the level of hospitality or professionalism we expect from our team.

We completely understand how upsetting it must have been to be left waiting while trying to finish your meal, and we’ll be addressing this internally with the team.

We’d truly appreciate the opportunity to welcome you back and give you the experience you deserved in the first place — **with the lights on, the food hot, and absolutely no surprise “closing ceremony”!** 😅 We hope you’ll give us another chance to serve you better. ❤️
